title: Building towers that stand
examples: Teacher, why should my tower have a wide bottom?
What shape makes a tower the strongest?
If I make my tower skinny, what happens?

explain.say: Today we are learning how to build towers that do not fall down.
A wide base helps your tower stay steady on the ground.
Next we need to think about keeping things level and balanced.
Triangles are very strong shapes that help your tower balance.
We can use these ideas to build a tower that lasts a long time.

items: Step 1: Start with a wide base
Step 3: Check that it stays balanced

explain.say: In real life, a bridge needs a wide base to cross a river.

faq.q: Why is a wide base better than a small base?
faq.a: A wide base gives your tower more room to stand without tipping over. It spreads the weight out so it feels safe.
asks: Why does a wide tower stand better?
What is the best bottom for a tower?

faq.a: Balance means making sure both sides of your tower weigh the same amount. If one side is heavier, it will tip.
asks: How do I keep my tower level?

faq.q: Are all shapes strong for towers?
faq.a: No, triangles are very strong because they lock into place. Squares are okay, but triangles are the best for support.
asks: Can I use circles for my tower?

faq.q: Do I need a wide base even if I build it low?
faq.a: Yes, even small towers need a base that is wider than the top part. This keeps everything grounded.
asks: Does the base size change with height?

faq.q: What is the most important thing to remember?
faq.a: The most important thing is to always think about the bottom first. A strong bottom helps everything else stay up.
asks: What should I think about first?
What is the secret to tall towers?

facts: A wider base makes a structure harder to tip over.
Triangles are very strong shapes because they distribute force well.
For a tower to balance, both sides must have equal weight.
The base should always be wider than the top layer.

quiz.say: If you build a tower on a small base, it is most likely to:

options.show: only be strong in the middle
options.say: only be strong in the middle

quiz.why: A small base does not have enough room to support the weight, so it will tip.

wrong.0: Weight is not the same as stability; a heavy tower can still fall.
wrong.1: Strength must come from all sides, not just the center.
wrong.3: This is wrong because a small base cannot handle the forces acting on it.

quiz.say: Which shape is best for making a strong corner in a tower?
quiz.why: The triangle shape locks together perfectly, making it very hard to push apart.

wrong.1: Squares can sometimes push apart at the corners if not supported.
wrong.2: Circles are good, but they do not lock together as strongly as triangles.
wrong.3: Rectangles are weak because they can bend sideways easily.

quiz.say: To make a tower balance, you must:

options.show: make the top bigger than the bottom
options.say: make the top bigger than the bottom

quiz.why: Balance means the weight on the left side must match the weight on the right side.

wrong.1: Height does not guarantee balance; the bottom must also be considered.
wrong.2: Using heavy blocks only makes the tower heavier, not necessarily more balanced.
wrong.3: The base must always be the widest part for stability.
